structured.name: Hyaluron Lip Oil For Plumper Looking Lips with Glass-like Shine
structured.description: Plump Ambition Hyaluron Lip Oil is infused with hyaluronic acid and tripeptides for smoother, plumper-looking lips with glass-like shine with 24-hour hydration.

additionalProperty.name: Benefits
additionalProperty.value: Plump Ambition Hyaluron Lip Oil by L’Oréal Paris is a volumizing, hydrating lip oil designed to deliver instantly smoother, plumper-looking lips with glass-like shine. Why Choose Plump Ambition Hyaluron Lip Oil?

additionalProperty.name: Ingredients
additionalProperty.value: Hyaluronic Acid What it does: A powerhouse hydrating ingredient recognized by dermatologists for its ability to attract and retain moisture, which helps keep skin plump and smooth. Why it matters: This moisture-locking ingredient acts as a high-performance treatment for delicate lip skin to deliver 24-hour hydration and nourishing lip care. Infused in this lip oil, it helps make lips appear less dry and significantly smoother over time. Tripeptides What it does: A chain of amino acids (peptides) that helps support the skin's structure, they help smooth the lip’s surface and improve the appearance of volume. Why it matters: Paired with Hyaluronic Acid, Tripeptides help smooth lips and make them appear instantly plumper-looking. Other Ingredients: C18-36 ACID TRIGLYCERIDE, BIS-DIGLYCERYL POLYACYLADIPATE-2, PENTAERYTHRITYL TETRAISOSTEARATE, POLYBUTENE, TRIDECYL TRIMELLITATE, DIISOSTEARYL MALATE, SILICA DIMETHYL SILYLATE [NANO] / SILICA DIMETHYL SILYLATE, ETHYLHEXYL PALMITATE, VANILLIN, PENTYLENE GLYCOL, CAPRYLYL GLYCOL, MENTHOL, PENTAERYTHRITYL TETRA-DI-T-BUTYL HYDROXYHYDROCINNAMATE, TRIBEHENIN, VANILLYL BUTYL ETHER, VANILLA PLANIFOLIA FRUIT EXTRACT, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, CALCIUM ALUMINUM BOROSILICATE, CALCIUM SODIUM BOROSILICATE, SYNTHETIC FLUORPHLOGOPITE, ALUMINA, SORBITAN ISOSTEARATE, TRIHYDROXYSTEARIN, SODIUM SACCHARIN, MENTHA PIPERITA OIL / PEPPERMINT OIL, SILICA, MAGNESIUM SILICATE, LACTIC ACID, SODIUM HYALURONATE, ALUMINUM HYDROXIDE, TIN OXIDE, PALMITOYL TRIPEPTIDE-1, LIMONENE, GLUCOMANNAN, [+/- MAY CONTAIN: CI 77891 / TITANIUM DIOXIDE, CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499 / IRON OXIDES, CI 15850 / RED 7, MICA, CI 15985 / YELLOW 6 LAKE, CI 45410 / RED 28 LAKE, CI 15850 / RED 6, CI 17200 / RED 33 LAKE, CI 45380 / RED 22 LAKE, CI 19140 / YELLOW 5 LAKE, CI 42090 / BLUE 1 LAKE, CI 75470 / CARMINE]. structured.name: HOW TO USE (ROUTINE STEPS) Plump Ambition Hyaluron Lip Oil For Plumper Looking Lips with Glass-like Shine

step.text: Step 1: Start at the Center. Using the cushiony pillow applicator, apply this hydrating lip oil starting in the center of your upper lip. Step 2: Work Outward. Work from the center to outer edges of your lips. Step 3: Coat Bottom Lip. Glide the cushiony pillow applicator across the entire bottom lip to coat it fully in hydrating gloss and color. Step 4: Wait for the Plump. Wait for gentle tingling sensation to subside to assess your glassy, plumper-looking lips. Feel free to layer as desired or reapply throughout the day.

acceptedAnswer.text: Lip oil is a skincare-infused lip product that combines the nourishing care of a balm with a high-shine, glossy finish. L'Oréal Paris's formula for Plump Ambition Hyaluron Lip Oil provides 24-hour hydration and is infused with Hyaluronic Acid and Tripeptides to help smooth lips and make them appear instantly plumper-looking.

mainEntity.name: What makes a lip oil different from lip gloss?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlike traditional lip gloss, a hydrating lip oil like Plump Ambition Hyaluron Lip Oil is infused with hyaluronic acid and tripeptides to deliver unparalleled nourshing lip care. The key difference is that this formula delivers a glass-like shine and nourishing care without the sticky or tacky residue often associated with a standard gloss, giving you a lightweight lip oil feel.

mainEntity.name: Can you wear lip oil every day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can wear this hydrating lip oil every day, or whenever your lips need shine, hydration, color, or a plumper-looking finish throughout the day. It offers 24-hour hydrating lip care and is lightweight, providing nurturing care even for sensitive lips.

mainEntity.name: Does lip oil add color to lips?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the plumping lip oil is a tinted formula available in 10 caring shades, providing a volumizing flush of color in one effortless swipe. There is also, however, a crystal clear shade for those desiring a hydrating, glass-like finish without color.

Yes. Plump Ambition Hyaluron Lip Oil is formulated to deliver 24-hour hydration and nourishing lip care. Infused with Hyaluronic Acid and Tripeptides, the formula helps make lips appear less dry and smoother over time, making it an ideal lip oil for dry lips.

mainEntity.name: How does Plump Ambition Hyaluron Lip Oil make my lips appear plumper?

acceptedAnswer.text: This plumping lip oil is infused with key ingredients like Hyaluronic Acid, Tripeptides, and peppermint oil, designed to deliver instantly smoother, plumper-looking lips. The formula delivers a volumizing, glass-like shine and a gentle tingling sensation, which contributes to lips looking fuller and bouncier.

structured.name: Azelaic Acid Suspension 10%
structured.description: A formula for blemish-prone skin to target uneven skin tone and texture.

mainEntity.name: How does Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% benefit the skin?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ordinary Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% visibly evens skin tone and targets uneven skin texture.

mainEntity.name: When should I use Azelaic Acid Suspension 10%?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ordinary Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% can be used in the Treat stage of your AM or PM routine, after water-based products, and before heavier treatments in your routine.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% with other ingredients?

acceptedAnswer.text: We recommend that you avoid using The Ordinary Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% with strong acids, retinoids, or peptides.

mainEntity.name: Is Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% suitable for sensitive skin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, The Ordinary Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% is generally well-tolerated, but we recommend patch testing before full application if you have sensitive skin.

mainEntity.name: Does Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% increase sun sensitivity?

acceptedAnswer.text: While azelaic acid does not significantly increase sun sensitivity, we still recommend using sun protection when applying The Ordinary Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% cream formulation during the day.
